model_description: 117-feature MLP (128-64-32-1, GELU+BatchNorm+Dropout 0.3). net-of-cost loss = MSE(cross-section z target) + lambda_to(0.05)*E|pred|. MC-dropout (T=30) → mu_tilde = mu_hat - k*SE (k=1). Walk-forward purged CV 10 folds (train>=5y, test 1y, embargo 30d). Lockbox sig_date<=2023-12-22. Identical 117-feature panel/target as tree-D for fair model-class comparison (NN vs tree).
economic_rationale: Factor 간 비선형 상호작용(value×momentum, quality×size, skewness×max_return, kurtosis×turnover)은 선형 합성/tree axis-aligned split로 불완전 포착. MLP가 연속·교차 비선형 함수를 근사해 tree(D)가 놓치는 잔여 nonlinear interaction alpha 추출. 실증: tree-D에 cross-section residualize 후에도 rank-IC=0.0240 (Harvey-t=3.10) 유지 → tree-D 신호 너머 incremental nonlinear 성분 존재.
redundancy_cluster_id: ML_daily_informed_monthly_cluster — D tree와 동일 117-feature panel/target. cluster 내 model-class 다각화(NN vs tree). cor vs D=0.347 = 동일 cluster 형제. residual-NN만 incremental orthogonal 성분.

factor_specs.formula: mu_hat = MLP(z_features); features = momentum/idiovol/beta/skew/kurt/liquidity/value/quality/size/regime x {raw, 21d&60d mean/std/zscore, rank_pct, rank_change, xs_zscore, 4 interaction terms}
factor_specs.lag_rule: fundamental quarterly 45d / annual May / price t-1 / daily rolling on Usable_Date<=sig_date (L-164 v1.1 ML carve-out)
